# NEW 2026-11-21 v9.5 Module 1: Imperial Governance Automation Console (oe_auto_, Slot 68). Generated by gen_empire_automation.py; edit the generator, not this file.
# Country scope unless noted. All automation engines are strictly is_ai = no (0 AI overhead).
# Zero overlap with Construction Manager: independent oe_auto_* vars, default OFF, instant = no, cost_multiplier = 1.0.

# Initialize or roll over current-year counters safely.
oe_auto_ensure_year_bucket = {
    if = {
        limit = {
            OR = {
                NOT = { has_variable = oe_auto_cur_yr }
                trigger_if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_auto_cur_yr } var:oe_auto_cur_yr < current_year }
                trigger_else = { always = no }
            }
        }
        set_variable = { name = oe_auto_cur_yr value = current_year }
        set_variable = { name = oe_auto_yr_granary value = 0 }
        set_variable = { name = oe_auto_yr_roads value = 0 }
        set_variable = { name = oe_auto_yr_trade value = 0 }
        set_variable = { name = oe_auto_yr_edu value = 0 }
        set_variable = { name = oe_auto_yr_total value = 0 }
        set_variable = { name = oe_auto_yr_prefect value = 0 }
        set_variable = { name = oe_auto_yr_diplo value = 0 }
    }
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_auto_life_total } }
        set_variable = { name = oe_auto_life_total value = 0 }
    }
}

# Country scope. Queue highest unlocked road type between scope:oe_auto_hub and scope:oe_auto_road_target.
oe_auto_queue_best_road = {
    if = {
        limit = { has_advance = railroad_advance }
        construct_road = {
            road_type = road_type:railroad
            from = scope:oe_auto_hub
            to = scope:oe_auto_road_target
        }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { has_advance = modern_road_advance }
        construct_road = {
            road_type = road_type:modern_road
            from = scope:oe_auto_hub
            to = scope:oe_auto_road_target
        }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { has_advance = paved_road_advance }
        construct_road = {
            road_type = road_type:paved_road
            from = scope:oe_auto_hub
            to = scope:oe_auto_road_target
        }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { has_advance = road_building }
        construct_road = {
            road_type = road_type:gravel_road
            from = scope:oe_auto_hub
            to = scope:oe_auto_road_target
        }
    }
}

# Engine 1 Priority 1: Emergency Granaries in starving / low-food provinces (single-layer bounded ordered_owned_location).
oe_auto_infra_pass_granary = {
    if = {
        limit = {
            oe_auto_infra_has_budget = yes
            can_build_building = building_type:granary
        }
        ordered_owned_location = {
            limit = {
                has_siege = no
                num_civil_constructions = 0
                oe_auto_is_urban_rank = yes
                NOT = { has_building_with_at_least_one_level = granary }
                can_build_building = building_type:granary
                province = {
                    OR = {
                        is_starving = yes
                        province_food_percentage < 0.35
                    }
                }
            }
            order_by = population
            max = 5
            check_range_bounds = no
            if = {
                limit = { root = { oe_auto_infra_has_budget = yes } }
                construct_building = {
                    building_type = building_type:granary
                    cost_multiplier = 1.0
                    cost_multiplier_reason = "game_concept_event"
                    instant = no
                }
                root = {
                    change_variable = { name = oe_auto_yr_granary add = 1 }
                    change_variable = { name = oe_auto_yr_total add = 1 }
                    change_variable = { name = oe_auto_life_total add = 1 }
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

# Engine 1 Priority 2: Low-control towns/cities linked to an adjacent high-control or capital-connected hub.
oe_auto_infra_pass_roads = {
    if = {
        limit = {
            oe_auto_infra_has_budget = yes
            oe_auto_has_any_road_tech = yes
        }
        ordered_owned_location = {
            limit = {
                has_siege = no
                has_road_constructions = no
                local_control < 0.55
                oe_auto_is_urban_rank = yes
                any_neighbor_location = {
                    has_owner = yes
                    owner = root
                    has_siege = no
                    has_road_constructions = no
                    OR = {
                        is_capital = yes
                        has_road_to_capital = yes
                        local_control >= 0.60
                    }
                    NOT = { has_latest_road_to = prev }
                }
            }
            order_by = population
            max = 5
            check_range_bounds = no
            if = {
                limit = { root = { oe_auto_infra_has_budget = yes } }
                save_scope_as = oe_auto_road_target
                ordered_neighbor_location = {
                    limit = {
                        has_owner = yes
                        owner = root
                        has_siege = no
                        has_road_constructions = no
                        OR = {
                            is_capital = yes
                            has_road_to_capital = yes
                            local_control >= 0.60
                        }
                        NOT = { has_latest_road_to = scope:oe_auto_road_target }
                    }
                    order_by = local_control
                    max = 1
                    check_range_bounds = no
                    save_scope_as = oe_auto_hub
                    root = {
                        oe_auto_queue_best_road = yes
                        change_variable = { name = oe_auto_yr_roads add = 1 }
                        change_variable = { name = oe_auto_yr_total add = 1 }
                        change_variable = { name = oe_auto_life_total add = 1 }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

# Engine 1 Priority 3: Major ports & market hubs (Marketplace & Dock).
oe_auto_infra_pass_trade = {
    if = {
        limit = {
            oe_auto_infra_has_budget = yes
            can_build_building = building_type:marketplace
        }
        ordered_owned_location = {
            limit = {
                has_siege = no
                num_civil_constructions = 0
                oe_auto_is_urban_rank = yes
                population >= 15
                OR = {
                    is_port = yes
                    is_market_center = yes
                }
                NOT = { has_building_with_at_least_one_level = marketplace }
                can_build_building = building_type:marketplace
            }
            order_by = population
            max = 5
            check_range_bounds = no
            if = {
                limit = { root = { oe_auto_infra_has_budget = yes } }
                construct_building = {
                    building_type = building_type:marketplace
                    cost_multiplier = 1.0
                    cost_multiplier_reason = "game_concept_event"
                    instant = no
                }
                root = {
                    change_variable = { name = oe_auto_yr_trade add = 1 }
                    change_variable = { name = oe_auto_yr_total add = 1 }
                    change_variable = { name = oe_auto_life_total add = 1 }
                }
            }
        }
    }
    if = {
        limit = {
            oe_auto_infra_has_budget = yes
            has_advance = dock_advance
            can_build_building = building_type:dock
        }
        ordered_owned_location = {
            limit = {
                has_siege = no
                num_civil_constructions = 0
                oe_auto_is_urban_rank = yes
                is_port = yes
                population >= 15
                NOT = { has_building_with_at_least_one_level = dock }
                can_build_building = building_type:dock
            }
            order_by = population
            max = 5
            check_range_bounds = no
            if = {
                limit = { root = { oe_auto_infra_has_budget = yes } }
                construct_building = {
                    building_type = building_type:dock
                    cost_multiplier = 1.0
                    cost_multiplier_reason = "game_concept_event"
                    instant = no
                }
                root = {
                    change_variable = { name = oe_auto_yr_trade add = 1 }
                    change_variable = { name = oe_auto_yr_total add = 1 }
                    change_variable = { name = oe_auto_life_total add = 1 }
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

# ENGINE 1 (Month 2): Treasury-Guarded Annual Infrastructure Patrol.
oe_auto_run_engine_1_infra = {
    if = {
        limit = { oe_auto_infra_ready = yes }
        oe_auto_ensure_year_bucket = yes
        oe_auto_infra_pass_granary = yes
        oe_auto_infra_pass_roads = yes
        oe_auto_infra_pass_trade = yes
        oe_auto_infra_pass_edu = yes
    }
}

# Scan distressed Theme / Prefecture / Exarchate subjects into O(1) readout var.
oe_auto_scan_prefect_warnings = {
    set_variable = { name = oe_auto_warn_low_loy_themes value = 0 }
    every_subject = {
        limit = {
            oe_auto_is_managed_prefect_subject = yes
            OR = {
                oe_auto_subject_is_distressed = yes
                num_loans > 0
            }
        }
        root = { change_variable = { name = oe_auto_warn_low_loy_themes add = 1 } }
    }
}

# ENGINE 2 (Month 3, after January oe_tq_yearly): Theme/Exarchate Deficit Replenishment & Prefecture Patrol.
oe_auto_run_engine_2_prefect = {
    if = {
        limit = { oe_auto_human_ok = yes }
        oe_auto_ensure_year_bucket = yes
        if = {
            limit = {
                num_loans = 0
                gold >= oe_auto_prefect_safe_gold
            }
            ordered_subject = {
                limit = { oe_auto_subject_needs_subsidy = yes }
                order_by = oe_auto_subject_deficit_score
                max = 2
                check_range_bounds = no
                if = {
                    limit = {
                        root = {
                            num_loans = 0
                            gold >= oe_auto_prefect_safe_gold
                        }
                    }
                    root = {
                        add_gold = -100
                        change_variable = { name = oe_auto_yr_prefect add = 1 }
                        change_variable = { name = oe_auto_life_total add = 1 }
                    }
                    add_gold = 100
                    add_liberty_desire = -5
                    add_country_modifier = {
                        modifier = oe_auto_mod_theme_subsidy
                        years = 1
                        mode = replace
                    }
                    if = {
                        limit = { oe_theme_member_trigger = yes }
                        oe_ts_recent_loy = { amount = 4 }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        oe_auto_scan_prefect_warnings = yes
    }
}

# Refresh all 4 diplomatic/subject/religious-order/parliament radar channels (microsecond-class scan).
oe_auto_refresh_diplo_radar = {
    oe_auto_scan_prefect_warnings = yes
    set_variable = { name = oe_auto_warn_disloyal_subs value = 0 }
    set_variable = { name = oe_auto_warn_rel_orders value = 0 }
    set_variable = { name = oe_auto_warn_parl_idle value = 0 }
    set_variable = { name = oe_auto_warn_far_ready value = 0 }
    set_variable = { name = oe_auto_warn_total value = 0 }

    # Channel 1: Disloyal / high liberty desire subjects
    every_subject = {
        limit = { oe_auto_subject_is_distressed = yes }
        root = {
            change_variable = { name = oe_auto_warn_disloyal_subs add = 1 }
            change_variable = { name = oe_auto_warn_total add = 1 }
        }
    }

    # Channel 2: Far Seas overseas lease/charter readiness (zero-error cross-line adapter)
    if = {
        limit = {
            oe_far_roman_host = yes
            OR = {
                AND = { oe_far_east_open = yes oe_far_any_east_lease = yes }
                AND = { oe_far_west_open = yes oe_far_any_west_lease = yes }
            }
        }
        set_variable = { name = oe_auto_warn_far_ready value = 1 }
        change_variable = { name = oe_auto_warn_total add = 1 }
    }

    # Channel 3: Religious Orders below Zeal 35 danger threshold
    if = {
        limit = { has_any_religious_order_presence = yes }
        every_religious_order_in_country = {
            limit = { religious_order_zeal < 35 }
            root = {
                change_variable = { name = oe_auto_warn_rel_orders add = 1 }
                change_variable = { name = oe_auto_warn_total add = 1 }
            }
        }
    }

    # Channel 4: Parliament off cooldown and idle 6+ months
    if = {
        limit = { oe_auto_parl_idle_trigger = yes }
        set_variable = { name = oe_auto_warn_parl_idle value = 1 }
        change_variable = { name = oe_auto_warn_total add = 1 }
    }
}

# ENGINE 3 (Month 6): Diplomatic, Subject, Religious Order & Parliament Expiry Radar.
oe_auto_run_engine_3_diplo = {
    if = {
        limit = { oe_auto_human_ok = yes }
        oe_auto_ensure_year_bucket = yes
        oe_auto_refresh_diplo_radar = yes
        if = {
            limit = { oe_auto_rd_warn_total >= 1 }
            change_variable = { name = oe_auto_yr_diplo add = 1 }
            change_variable = { name = oe_auto_life_total add = 1 }
            if = {
                limit = { var:oe_auto_ledger_popup ?= 1 }
                trigger_event_non_silently = oe_auto.20
            }
        }
    }
}

# One-click renewal action A: Batch pacify up to 5 disloyal/strained subjects (60 gold each).
oe_auto_batch_pacify_subjects = {
    if = {
        limit = { oe_auto_human_ok = yes }
        oe_auto_ensure_year_bucket = yes
        ordered_subject = {
            limit = {
                NOT = { has_country_modifier = oe_auto_mod_subject_stipend }
                OR = {
                    liberty_desire >= 40
                    subject_loyalty < 55
                    AND = {
                        has_variable = oe_theme_loyalty_band
                        var:oe_theme_loyalty_band <= 1
                    }
                }
            }
            order_by = liberty_desire
            max = 5
            check_range_bounds = no
            if = {
                limit = { root = { gold >= 60 } }
                root = {
                    add_gold = -60
                    change_variable = { name = oe_auto_yr_diplo add = 1 }
                    change_variable = { name = oe_auto_life_total add = 1 }
                }
                add_gold = 60
                add_liberty_desire = -10
                add_country_modifier = {
                    modifier = oe_auto_mod_subject_stipend
                    years = 5
                    mode = replace
                }
                if = {
                    limit = { oe_theme_member_trigger = yes }
                    oe_ts_recent_loy = { amount = 6 }
                }
            }
        }
        oe_auto_refresh_diplo_radar = yes
    }
}

# One-click renewal action B: Emergency Prefecture/Theme/Exarchate tribute relief (100 gold each, max 3).
oe_auto_emergency_pacify_prefects = {
    if = {
        limit = { oe_auto_human_ok = yes }
        oe_auto_ensure_year_bucket = yes
        ordered_subject = {
            limit = {
                oe_auto_is_managed_prefect_subject = yes
                NOT = { has_country_modifier = oe_auto_mod_prefect_relief }
                OR = {
                    oe_auto_subject_is_distressed = yes
                    num_loans > 0
                }
            }
            order_by = liberty_desire
            max = 3
            check_range_bounds = no
            if = {
                limit = { root = { gold >= 100 } }
                root = {
                    add_gold = -100
                    change_variable = { name = oe_auto_yr_prefect add = 1 }
                    change_variable = { name = oe_auto_life_total add = 1 }
                }
                add_gold = 100
                add_liberty_desire = -12
                add_country_modifier = {
                    modifier = oe_auto_mod_prefect_relief
                    years = 2
                    mode = replace
                }
                if = {
                    limit = { oe_theme_member_trigger = yes }
                    oe_ts_recent_loy = { amount = 8 }
                }
            }
        }
        oe_auto_refresh_diplo_radar = yes
    }
}

# One-click renewal action C: Endow up to 3 low-zeal religious orders (80 gold each -> +18 Zeal).
oe_auto_fund_religious_orders = {
    if = {
        limit = {
            oe_auto_human_ok = yes
            has_any_religious_order_presence = yes
        }
        oe_auto_ensure_year_bucket = yes
        ordered_religious_order_in_country = {
            limit = { religious_order_zeal < 35 }
            order_by = { value = 100 subtract = religious_order_zeal }
            max = 3
            check_range_bounds = no
            if = {
                limit = { root = { gold >= 80 } }
                root = {
                    add_gold = -80
                    change_variable = { name = oe_auto_yr_diplo add = 1 }
                    change_variable = { name = oe_auto_life_total add = 1 }
                }
                change_religious_order_zeal = 18
            }
        }
        oe_auto_refresh_diplo_radar = yes
    }
}

# ENGINE 4 (Month 12): Annual Transparent Ledger Archival & optional .90 popup.
oe_auto_run_engine_4_ledger = {
    if = {
        limit = { oe_auto_human_ok = yes }
        oe_auto_ensure_year_bucket = yes
        oe_auto_refresh_diplo_radar = yes
        set_variable = { name = oe_auto_last_yr value = current_year }
        set_variable = { name = oe_auto_last_granary value = oe_auto_rd_yr_granary }
        set_variable = { name = oe_auto_last_roads value = oe_auto_rd_yr_roads }
        set_variable = { name = oe_auto_last_trade value = oe_auto_rd_yr_trade }
        set_variable = { name = oe_auto_last_edu value = oe_auto_rd_yr_edu }
        set_variable = { name = oe_auto_last_total value = oe_auto_rd_yr_total }
        set_variable = { name = oe_auto_last_prefect value = oe_auto_rd_yr_prefect }
        set_variable = { name = oe_auto_last_diplo value = oe_auto_rd_yr_diplo }
        set_variable = { name = oe_auto_yr_granary value = 0 }
        set_variable = { name = oe_auto_yr_roads value = 0 }
        set_variable = { name = oe_auto_yr_trade value = 0 }
        set_variable = { name = oe_auto_yr_edu value = 0 }
        set_variable = { name = oe_auto_yr_total value = 0 }
        set_variable = { name = oe_auto_yr_prefect value = 0 }
        set_variable = { name = oe_auto_yr_diplo value = 0 }
        if = {
            limit = { var:oe_auto_ledger_popup ?= 1 }
            trigger_event_non_silently = oe_auto.90
        }
    }
}

# ==============================================================================
# Slot 68 Scheduler Entry Point (called by oe_mainline_lock.txt Slot 68 & oe_auto_pulse.txt fallback)
# Strictly is_ai = no + monthly dedup via var:oe_auto_ran_m -> zero double runs, zero AI overhead.
# ==============================================================================
oe_auto_monthly = {
    if = {
        limit = {
            oe_auto_human_ok = yes
            NOT = { var:oe_auto_ran_m ?= oe_auto_m_now }
        }
        set_variable = { name = oe_auto_ran_m value = oe_auto_m_now }
        if = {
            limit = { var:oe_auto_master_on ?= 1 }
            if = {
                limit = { current_month = 2 var:oe_auto_infra_on ?= 1 }
                oe_auto_run_engine_1_infra = yes
            }
            if = {
                limit = { current_month = 3 var:oe_auto_prefect_on ?= 1 }
                oe_auto_run_engine_2_prefect = yes
            }
            if = {
                limit = { current_month = 6 var:oe_auto_diplo_on ?= 1 }
                oe_auto_run_engine_3_diplo = yes
            }
            if = {
                limit = { current_month = 12 }
                oe_auto_run_engine_4_ledger = yes
            }
        }
    }
}

# ==============================================================================
# Player Console Toggles & Configuration Helpers
# ==============================================================================
oe_auto_toggle_master = {
    if = {
        limit = { var:oe_auto_master_on ?= 1 }
        set_variable = { name = oe_auto_master_on value = 0 }
    }
    else = {
        set_variable = { name = oe_auto_master_on value = 1 }
        oe_auto_ensure_year_bucket = yes
    }
}

oe_auto_toggle_infra = {
    if = { limit = { var:oe_auto_infra_on ?= 1 } set_variable = { name = oe_auto_infra_on value = 0 } }
    else = { set_variable = { name = oe_auto_infra_on value = 1 } }
}

oe_auto_toggle_prefect = {
    if = { limit = { var:oe_auto_prefect_on ?= 1 } set_variable = { name = oe_auto_prefect_on value = 0 } }
    else = { set_variable = { name = oe_auto_prefect_on value = 1 } }
}

oe_auto_toggle_diplo = {
    if = { limit = { var:oe_auto_diplo_on ?= 1 } set_variable = { name = oe_auto_diplo_on value = 0 } }
    else = { set_variable = { name = oe_auto_diplo_on value = 1 } }
}

oe_auto_toggle_war_ok = {
    if = { limit = { var:oe_auto_war_infra_ok ?= 1 } set_variable = { name = oe_auto_war_infra_ok value = 0 } }
    else = { set_variable = { name = oe_auto_war_infra_ok value = 1 } }
}

oe_auto_toggle_popup = {
    if = { limit = { var:oe_auto_ledger_popup ?= 1 } set_variable = { name = oe_auto_ledger_popup value = 0 } }
    else = { set_variable = { name = oe_auto_ledger_popup value = 1 } }
}

oe_auto_cycle_floor = {
    if = { limit = { var:oe_auto_treasury_floor ?= 1 } set_variable = { name = oe_auto_treasury_floor value = 2 } }
    else_if = { limit = { var:oe_auto_treasury_floor ?= 2 } set_variable = { name = oe_auto_treasury_floor value = 3 } }
    else_if = { limit = { var:oe_auto_treasury_floor ?= 3 } set_variable = { name = oe_auto_treasury_floor value = 4 } }
    else_if = { limit = { var:oe_auto_treasury_floor ?= 4 } set_variable = { name = oe_auto_treasury_floor value = 1 } }
    else = { set_variable = { name = oe_auto_treasury_floor value = 3 } }
}

oe_auto_cycle_cap = {
    if = { limit = { var:oe_auto_annual_cap ?= 2 } set_variable = { name = oe_auto_annual_cap value = 3 } }
    else_if = { limit = { var:oe_auto_annual_cap ?= 5 } set_variable = { name = oe_auto_annual_cap value = 2 } }
    else = { set_variable = { name = oe_auto_annual_cap value = 5 } }
}

oe_auto_reset_stats = {
    set_variable = { name = oe_auto_cur_yr value = current_year }
    set_variable = { name = oe_auto_yr_granary value = 0 }
    set_variable = { name = oe_auto_yr_roads value = 0 }
    set_variable = { name = oe_auto_yr_trade value = 0 }
    set_variable = { name = oe_auto_yr_edu value = 0 }
    set_variable = { name = oe_auto_yr_total value = 0 }
    set_variable = { name = oe_auto_yr_prefect value = 0 }
    set_variable = { name = oe_auto_yr_diplo value = 0 }
    set_variable = { name = oe_auto_last_yr value = 0 }
    set_variable = { name = oe_auto_last_granary value = 0 }
    set_variable = { name = oe_auto_last_roads value = 0 }
    set_variable = { name = oe_auto_last_trade value = 0 }
    set_variable = { name = oe_auto_last_edu value = 0 }
    set_variable = { name = oe_auto_last_total value = 0 }
    set_variable = { name = oe_auto_last_prefect value = 0 }
    set_variable = { name = oe_auto_last_diplo value = 0 }
    set_variable = { name = oe_auto_life_total value = 0 }
}

oe_auto_emergency_pause_all = {
    set_variable = { name = oe_auto_master_on value = 0 }
    set_variable = { name = oe_auto_infra_on value = 0 }
    set_variable = { name = oe_auto_prefect_on value = 0 }
    set_variable = { name = oe_auto_diplo_on value = 0 }
}

oe_auto_test_enable_all = {
    set_variable = { name = oe_auto_master_on value = 1 }
    set_variable = { name = oe_auto_infra_on value = 1 }
    set_variable = { name = oe_auto_prefect_on value = 1 }
    set_variable = { name = oe_auto_diplo_on value = 1 }
    if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_auto_treasury_floor } } set_variable = { name = oe_auto_treasury_floor value = 2 } }
    if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_auto_annual_cap } } set_variable = { name = oe_auto_annual_cap value = 3 } }
    oe_auto_ensure_year_bucket = yes
}

oe_auto_test_disable_all = {
    set_variable = { name = oe_auto_master_on value = 0 }
}

    oe_auto_ensure_year_bucket = yes
    oe_auto_run_engine_1_infra = yes
}

    oe_auto_run_engine_2_prefect = yes

    oe_auto_monthly = yes
}
